title: Skein relations for invariants of Legendrian surfaces
summary: For Legendrian surfaces in 1-jet spaces, we consider augmentation number invariants that together generalize the ruling polynomial of 1-dimensional Legendrian knots and establish skein relations for these invariants. The main skein relation involves four ways of resolving a Legendrian with a double point: perturbing the double point to a contractible Reeb chord in two different ways, and removing the double point via the two Lagrangian surgeries. We apply the skein relations in examples, and use them to provide an alternate proof of the relation between augmentations of Legendrian 2-weaves…
